facts.fact: 母亲把一张写着 STAY LATE 的纸片留在衣堆上，Beatrice 折好收进口袋
后巷里母亲先开口，问切除是不是没成功
facts.anchor: “It didn’t work, did it?” she asks me. “The excision, I mean.”

facts.fact: 母亲说她在 Evelyn 的葬礼之前就已经知道这件事
facts.anchor: “I’ve known since before Evelyn’s funeral,” she says, looking grave.

facts.fact: 母亲警告：身份被人知道的人最后都死了，并逼她回答听懂了没有
facts.anchor: Those who have . . . they end up dead. Do you understand?

facts.fact: 母亲说无派系者分两类：她见过的，和她从没见过的
facts.anchor: There are two types of factionless, Beatrice. The kind you’ve seen . . . and the kind you’ve never seen.

facts.fact: 母亲说她知道一个可以去的地方，并说自己在无派系者中间有联系人
facts.anchor: “I know a place you can go. I have a contact among the factionless,” she says.

facts.fact: 母亲暗示开枪的人目标可能不是 Robert
facts.anchor: “Maybe,” she says delicately, “they weren’t aiming for Robert.”

facts.fact: Beatrice 自己把「叛逃」这条没说出口的路说出来
